english.title: Rescue goods seized in execution under process of a county court
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) rescued goods, namely **(..SPECIFY GOODS..), seized in execution under process of the county court at **(..SPECIFY LOCATION OF COUNTY COURT..)
english.legislation: Contrary to section 92(1) of the County Courts Act 1984.
english.pointstoprove:
date and location
rescue goods seized in execution

investigatoraction.description: Guilty Plea by letter procedure may be offered for this offence

DNA Samples: If crime scene stain present - take evidential sample If no crime scene stain and DNA not confirmed on PNC - take Criminal Justice sample. If DNA confirmed on PNC - CJ sample not required
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes: A bailiff of the court may take the offender into custody, with or without warrant, and bring him before the judge.
english.standardstatementoffacts: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) the defendant rescued goods, namely **(..SPECIFY GOODS..), seized in execution under process of the county court at **(..SPECIFY LOCATION OF COUNTY COURT..).

other.penalty:
